title: Overview
description: Provides a high-level introduction to the Requests library, its purpose, main features, and a quick-start code example.

title: Installation
description: Guides users on how to install the library, detailing supported Python versions and dependencies.

title: Core Usage
description: Covers the fundamental patterns for making HTTP requests and handling responses using the simple functional API.

title: Making a Request
description: Demonstrates how to perform various HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, etc., and explains the basic request-response cycle.

title: Passing URL Parameters
description: Explains how to send data in the URL's query string using the `params` argument for GET requests.

title: Handling Response Content
description: Details how to access the response body as bytes (.content), text (.text), and deserialized JSON (.json()).

title: POSTing Data
description: Covers various methods for sending data in the request body, including form-encoded data, multipart file uploads, and raw JSON payloads.

title: Advanced Usage
description: Explores more complex features for building robust and reliable HTTP applications, such as session management, authentication, and error handling.

title: Session Objects
description: Explains how to use Session objects for cookie persistence, connection pooling, and default request configuration.

title: Authentication
description: Details the various authentication schemes supported, including Basic and Digest authentication, and how to implement custom auth.

title: Proxies
description: Provides instructions on how to route requests through a proxy server for both HTTP and HTTPS.

title: SSL Certificate Verification
description: Covers how Requests handles SSL certificate verification and how to use custom or client-side certificates.

title: Timeouts
description: Explains how to set connect and read timeouts to prevent requests from hanging indefinitely.

title: Error Handling
description: A guide to the exception hierarchy in Requests, explaining how to catch and handle various network and protocol errors.

title: API Reference
description: Provides a detailed, comprehensive reference for all public classes, methods, and functions in the Requests library.

title: Request and Response Objects
description: A detailed reference for the `Request`, `PreparedRequest`, and `Response` objects, including all their methods and attributes.

title: Session Object
description: Comprehensive API documentation for the `Session` object, detailing its methods for making requests and managing state.

title: Exceptions
description: A complete listing of all public exceptions raised by the library, explaining their inheritance and when they occur.

title: Community
description: Information for developers who want to contribute to the project, view the license, or see the project's history.

title: Contributing
description: Provides guidelines for contributing to the Requests library, including how to set up the development environment and run tests.

title: Release History
description: A detailed changelog documenting all improvements, bug fixes, and security updates for every version of Requests.

title: License
description: Displays the Apache 2.0 license under which the Requests library is distributed.
